messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] HIGH: billing.metering.token_delta > 12% (15m rolling). Triggered 2026-03-17T02:14:10Z. Pager: @sam_ops
Liang_SRE: acknowledged, I'm on pager
sam_ops: on it. pulling recent counts from agg
sam_ops: run:
```SELECT window_start, sum(tokens) AS tokens FROM billing.tokens_agg WHERE window_start > now()-interval '30 minutes' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 12;```
maria_billing: I see delayed emits from emitter-proxy in us-east-1, ~30-40m lag on some partitions
sam_ops: that matches. emitter-proxy logs show backpressure: `WARN queue_size=9876` — looks like a regression from last deploy
jess_pm: any customer-visible overage flags? we already have a few automated alerts
billing-eng: we have 12 customers flagged in the last hour, likely false positives
Liang_SRE: can we pause overage flagging? billing-eng, can you flip the kill-switch? @billing-eng
billing-eng: flipping `overage_detector.enabled=false` in prod now (rolling). `/deploy toggle overage_detector=false --env=prod`
incident-bot: deploy: toggle job started by billing-eng
sam_ops: also rolling back emitter-proxy v2.3.1 -> v2.2.9 on us-east-1, initiating canary rollback
maria_billing: started backfill job for delayed windows: `backfill_emits --since 2026-03-17T01:30Z --target=agg` (wip)
sam_ops: probing counts post-rollback: counts delta down to 3% over last 15m, heartbeats restored
billing-eng: paused billing alerts, marking affected customers for manual review. proposing temporary credits for any customer charged due to this
jess_pm: agree. I'll draft a short customer note. We should include: root cause (ingest backpressure), mitigation (rollback + backfill), expected window for corrected invoices
Liang_SRE: recommend keeping `overage_detector.enabled=false` for 2 hours, then re-evaluate; add a watch on emit-latency metric
sam_ops: monitoring dashboards look green. emit latency down from 2.8s to 90ms. need one more confirmation from backfill
billing-eng: backfill currently processing 1800 windows, ETA ~25m
jess_pm: draft ready, will send after billing-eng confirms backfill complete; set internal retrospective
sam_ops: confirmed backfill finished, metrics stable. closing pager
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: billing.metering.token_delta normalized. Duration: 42m
jess_pm: created PR for postmortem and follow-ups: add emitter proxy circuit-breaker + automatic pause on queue_size>5000
Liang_SRE: thx everyone. I'll follow up on the release that introduced regression
maria_billing: filing customer credits request (ticket #CRM-4592)
billing-eng: created rollback runbook entry and feature-flag safety check
sam_ops: thanks all. :thumbsup:
